about_short_description.short_description: InstaKin helps immigrants to manage projects and tasks in their home countries, connecting them with vendors and securely handling payments.

product.name: InstaShop
product.description: An ecommerce store within the InstaKin app for purchasing consumer electronics, gifts, toys, and mobile phones to send to family back home.

product.name: InstaRunner
product.description: A delivery service that provides fast courier transport for parcels such as documents, gifts, groceries, and errands within the home country.

product.name: Special Request Service
product.description: A service to handle unique or uncommon tasks back home, including urgent deliveries, property management, and home repairs like plumbing or electrical work.

product.name: Secure Payment Platform
product.description: A payment system integrated into InstaKin that ensures secure processing of credit/debit card transactions for all services.

product.name: WhatsApp Ordering Bot
product.description: A WhatsApp-based bot that allows users to place orders for their friends and family through WhatsApp messaging.
